shema-yisrael.sources: // Sources: the song file (the parts' guide notes), tools: ~/Code/arranger-keep/partfacts.py; licence.source: Israel Goldfarb and Samuel E. Goldfarb, Synagogue Melodies for the High Holy Days (Brooklyn, 1926), Nos. 18 and 19, p. 17, one unison line for the congregation, G major, 3/4, "Traditional"; our own SATB

parts.soprano: Carries the congregational tune, most often on G, then B and A, up to its top C only on the "shem" of the first "Adoshem" and the "vod" of "kevod", and down to its low G on the "Yis-" of "Yisrael,", the "A-do-" of the first "Adoshem", the "E-" of "Elokeinu,", the "A-" of the second "Adoshem", the "chad." of "echad.", the "ruch" of "Baruch", the "ke-" of "kevod", the "mal-" of "malchuto", the "le'-" of "le'olam" and the "ed." of "va'ed.".
parts.alto: Sings under the tune, mostly a third or a sixth below it, most often on E and F-sharp, then B, up to its top G on "Sh'ma", the "el," of "Yisrael,", the "kei-" of "Elokeinu,", the "shem" after "Baruch" and the "to" of "malchuto", and down to its low B on the "chad." of "echad." and the "ed." of "va'ed.", where it ends a sixth under the tune.
parts.tenor: Sings the middle of the chord, most often on D, then G and C, up to its top D on all of "Sh'ma Yisrael,", the "kei-" of "Elokeinu,", "Baruch shem" and the "to" of "malchuto", and down to its low D, an octave under it, only on the "ed." that ends the song.
parts.bass: Sings the bass line, on the chords' roots about three quarters of the time, most often on D, then G, up to its top G on "Sh'ma" and the "Yis-ra-" of "Yisrael," and on "Baruch", holding D from the "kei-" of "Elokeinu," to the "e-" of "echad." and from the "to" of "malchuto" to the "va'-" of "va'ed.", and down to its low G, an octave under its top, on the "chad." of "echad." and the "ed." of "va'ed.".

parts_es.soprano: Canta la melodía de la congregación, con más frecuencia en el Sol, luego en el Si y el La, sube a su Do agudo solo en el "shem" del primer "Adoshem" y en el "vod" de "kevod", y baja a su Sol grave en el "Yis-" de "Yisrael,", el "A-do-" del primer "Adoshem", el "E-" de "Elokeinu,", el "A-" del segundo "Adoshem", el "chad." de "echad.", el "ruch" de "Baruch", el "ke-" de "kevod", el "mal-" de "malchuto", el "le'-" de "le'olam" y el "ed." de "va'ed.".
parts_es.alto: Canta por debajo de la melodía, casi siempre una tercera o una sexta más abajo, con más frecuencia en el Mi y el Fa sostenido, luego en el Si, sube a su Sol agudo en "Sh'ma", el "el," de "Yisrael,", el "kei-" de "Elokeinu,", el "shem" que sigue a "Baruch" y el "to" de "malchuto", y baja a su Si grave en el "chad." de "echad." y el "ed." de "va'ed.", donde termina una sexta por debajo de la melodía.
parts_es.tenor: Canta el centro del acorde, con más frecuencia en el Re, luego en el Sol y el Do, sube a su Re agudo en todo "Sh'ma Yisrael,", el "kei-" de "Elokeinu,", "Baruch shem" y el "to" de "malchuto", y baja a su Re grave, una octava más abajo, solo en el "ed." que cierra la canción.
parts_es.bass: Canta la línea del bajo, en la fundamental de los acordes cerca de tres cuartas partes del tiempo, con más frecuencia en el Re, luego en el Sol, sube a su Sol agudo en "Sh'ma", el "Yis-ra-" de "Yisrael," y en "Baruch", mantiene el Re desde el "kei-" de "Elokeinu," hasta el "e-" de "echad." y desde el "to" de "malchuto" hasta el "va'-" de "va'ed.", y baja a su Sol grave, una octava por debajo del agudo, en el "chad." de "echad." y el "ed." de "va'ed.".
